Add education document worker, processor registry, and monitoring

- Implement education document worker with processor registry and
  trait-based architecture
- Add support for gotenberg and any2pdf document processors (stubbed for
  now)
- Add markdown, HTML, image, and PDF processors with template support
- Add Aliyun OSS upload for normalized PDFs with metadata
- Add document worker and task run monitoring tables and APIs
- Add Camellia pages for document center, worker/task monitoring, and
  processor selection
- Update configs, env examples, and migrations for new document
  processing features
- Add tests for processor registry, PDF key generation, and monitoring
  flows
